prompt: A gold-rush boom town that grows fast around the mine.

card.name: Goldvein Boomtown

site.text: A sprawling town on a hillside sloping down from a mine entrance, streets spreading outward from the mine head

style.text: Wild-west frontier boom town: weathered spruce and oak planks, false-front buildings, lanterns, rough hasty additions, tents and scaffolding

purpose.text: Gold-rush mining boom town that grows fast around the mine

card.interpretation: I read this as a frontier gold-rush town: a hillside mine at the centre with buildings spreading outward in a hasty, crowded way. Style is a rough wild-west rustic look, purpose is a mining outpost that doubles as a boom town, and the density is high to give the sense of fast growth. No backstory was given, so none was added.
assumptions: Size M, fitting a 64-block claim radius
High density to show fast growth
Existing hilly terrain used, no sculpting
Difficulty patron from the world default settings

program.notes: Timber headframe over the main shaft with ore carts and a winch; the town grows around it
Sturdy stone-and-plank building with gold scales and a vault
Big false-front saloon with balcony and piano, busiest building in town
Supplies, picks, barrels and crates out front
Hasty, mismatched small cabins and tent-like lean-tos, clustered near the mine
Two-storey rooms for rent, newly built
Crushes ore, runs sluice troughs for gold washing
